Every human instruction carries a mountain of unstated assumptions ("bring me coffee" does not mean "bring me coffee *at any cost*"), and an AI only knows what we actually specify.

We usually train AI by giving it a score to maximize. Here's the trap, called **Goodhart's law**: *"When a measure becomes a target, it stops being a good measure."*
